title: Badminton with my friend!
author: SoftFine859
selftext: so i basically let opus 5.5 watch the footage of real badminton matches and research on academic papers about limb movement related to grip, footwork etc and he gives me the framework, now im having so much fun with my friend and the game supports up to 4 online players :D
